courseTitle: Game Development in JS/TS - The Complete Guide (w/ Phaser 3)

cues.en: Hey guys, welcome in under section Introduction.
In the following lectures you will start handling the movement of the player.
So we'll be working on a simple navigation so we can go and run to the left.
To the right, we can jump and also we'll add an animation to all of these movements so we can run to
the right, to the left and we can jump.
Then we'll create also end of the level and we'll introduce some concepts like a mixins.
Okay, so here is the end of the level and after the player will reach the end of the level, we should
be displaying in the console that we have basically won.
So that's the from the visuals, how it looks like the our game.
And also you can see the game is zoomed more so we can see that there is more focus on the player.
From the code perspective, what you are going to work on will be the navigation.
As I told you, some events will initialize to handle these movements player animations.
We will add a colliders between the player and other game objects.
So I hope to see you in the lectures and we will be implementing all of this together.
